description: Objetivos y medidas de mitigación y adaptación ante el cambio climático establecidas en la Primera Contribución Determinada a Nivel Nacional is a dataset listed in Uruguayan national open data catalogue (catalogodatos.gub.uy), an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministerio de Ambiente. Grado de avance e información metodológica de los Objetivos de Mitigación y Medidas de Mitigación, adaptación y Fortalecimiento de capacidades que aportan al alcance de dichos Objetivos, establecidos en la Primera Contribución Determinada a Nivel Nacional (CDN) acorde a la Política Nacional de Cambio Climático (PNCC). Coverage: Uruguay. The portal files it under the publisher Ministerio de Ambiente. Its tags are CDN, Cambio climático, MA, MRV, NDC. It offers 27 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, XLSX, XML. The portal shows 2026-01-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licencia de DAG de Uruguay. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-uy-portal.
